arch-check.name: arch-check
arch-check.description: 分析项目模块依赖图，检测循环依赖、中心模块、分层违规
arch-check.author: ai-developer-growth

check.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from tools.scripts.rules_engine.arch import DependencyGraph; g = DependencyGraph(); issues = g.analyze_directory(Path('.')); print(f'模块数: {g.module_count}, 依赖数: {g.edge_count}, 架构问题: {len(issues)}'); [print(f'  [{i.severity}] {i.category}: {i.message}') for i in issues]"

team-patterns.name: team-patterns
team-patterns.description: 分析团队编码模式——命名风格、错误处理习惯、高频违规
team-patterns.author: ai-developer-growth

learn.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from tools.scripts.rules_engine.pattern_learner import PatternLearner; patterns = PatternLearner().learn_from_directory(Path('.')); print(f'分析完成, 发现 {len(patterns)} 个模式'); [print(f'[{p.get(\"type\",\"pattern\")}] {p.get(\"message\",p.get(\"pattern\",\"\"))} (置信度:{p.get(\"confidence\",0):.0%})') for p in patterns[:10]]"

quality-snapshot.name: quality-snapshot
quality-snapshot.description: 记录当前项目质量快照——错误数、警告数、文件数，存入质量趋势。支持 sparkline 迷你趋势图和多点对比表格。
quality-snapshot.author: ai-developer-growth

take.description: 记录质量快照 + 趋势摘要
take.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from tools.scripts.rules_engine.quality_trends import QualityTracker; t = QualityTracker(); s = t.take_snapshot(Path('.')); r = t.generate_trend_report(); print(t.generate_summary(r)); print(); print(t.format_trend_report(r))"

trend.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from tools.scripts.rules_engine.quality_trends import QualityTracker; t = QualityTracker(); s = t.take_snapshot(Path('.')); print(f'Sparkline (issues): {t.generate_sparkline(\"total_issues\")}'); print(f'Sparkline (errors):  {t.generate_sparkline(\"errors\")}'); print(); r = t.generate_trend_report(); print(t.format_trend_report(r))"

multi.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from tools.scripts.rules_engine.quality_trends import QualityTracker; t = QualityTracker(); s = t.take_snapshot(Path('.')); print(t.generate_multi_trend_report())"

sparkline.description: 仅显示 sparkline 迷你趋势图
sparkline.command: python -c "from tools.scripts.rules_engine.quality_trends import QualityTracker; t = QualityTracker(); print(f'Issues sparkline: {t.generate_sparkline(\"total_issues\")}'); print(f'Errors sparkline:  {t.generate_sparkline(\"errors\")}')"

details.description: 显示详细反馈数据（含自动排除/降级详情）

list.description: 列出可用和已启用的领域规则包
list.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; domains_dir = Path('ai-dev-framework/domains'); print('可用领域规则包:'); [print(f'  {f.stem}: {len(yaml.safe_load(f.read_text()).get(\"anti_patterns\",[]))} 条') for f in sorted(domains_dir.glob('*.yml'))]"
